question: 按性别统计 2014 年交易税，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dc.Gender AS gender, SUM(ft.Tax) AS total_trade_tax FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2014 GROUP BY dc.Gender ORDER BY total_trade_tax DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 交易税以货币金额度量
Gender 是客户(自然人)属性
